name: v51-m3-spec-first
budget_note: PRELIMINARY BUDGET: this host has no bf16 units (fp32 training 3x faster than emulated bf16, but 2.9x slower than the AMX host v5 trained on), so a 72-step run takes ~3.3 h. Both arms use 24 steps (one third of the production budget), fp32 training and 2 seeds, to fit two matched seed pairs in the mission window. Results are preliminary and not directly comparable with 72-step runs.
note: Control vs one targeted data intervention. Phase 2 found that most unseen-task failures are task interpretation errors: the code of a neighbouring trained function with the one word that differs ignored (fourth_item -> items[4], first_three_chars -> s[:2], longest_word -> min). Treatment B changes only the answer format of the existing verified write examples: each written function starts with a docstring restating the task from the prompt, then the same code (basics.SPEC_FIRST). Same checkpoint (round 54), token budget (24 steps x 4 x 1024 packed tokens per arm, see budget_note), optimizer (Lion, lr 1.5e-5, WSD schedule), layers (top 24), evaluation and matched seeds. Skill functions off in both arms. Decision metric: unseen_clean = clean dev (/44) + unseen-concept set (/53).
